create_patterns.name: selection-loaded-nothing-despite-explicit-keyword-match.md
create_patterns.content: In all 8 traces (t1-t8) the agent loaded no skill, even when the task text named the transform. Examples: 'Heat a tomato' (t2), 'cooled plate' (t3), 'clean fork' (t7), 'two spray bottles' (t5). Every iteration scored val_f1 0.000. Fix: load the skill whose cue word matches (heat, cool, clean, two). Use pick_and_place for a plain put.

create_patterns.name: selection-ignored-cue-words-inside-long-task-text.md
create_patterns.content: The cue can sit inside a longer sentence. 'cupboard beneath the sink' (t3) is a distractor, and the real cue is 'cooled'. 'microwave ... cabinet above it' (t6) means heat. 'two sets of keys' (t8) means pick_two_obj_and_place. Choose the skill from the transform word or the count, not from the location nouns.
